title: One language, kept
sub: Data architecture, a series on what DAMA calls data architecture, between the business and the systems: one language for the data, kept with the map, with names built from parts, the industry's reference model, a few principles and decisions written down, and every change checked against them.
howto: Glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model: gold is the business layer, peach the information layer, where data architecture works. A change is a dark card in code blue, with the table it would make: a red ring marks a name the review stops, a gold tick what passes. The glossary is a gold card, each meaning with its owner on a chip. Chile in 1972 is drawn in lamp-light: the telex, two factories' sheets, one definition, the operations room and the daily report.
